Name: Consultation Not Completed
Description: Patient not available or consultation cancelled, with reason

Name: Medico-Legal Case
Description: Medico-legal case documentation and police intimation

Name: Medical Certificate
Description: Medical certificate issued to the patient

Name: Admission Request
Description: Request from OPD or Emergency to admit the patient to a ward

Name: Admission Details
Description: Admission details recorded on the ward (treating team, admission type and source, MLC, consent)

Name: Change of Treating Team
Description: Responsibility for an inpatient passed to another doctor or unit

Name: Nursing Handover
Description: Nursing handover when an inpatient moves ward

Name: Discharge Advice
Description: Doctor's discharge advice with the exit outcome and discharge summary narrative
